A '''stormtrooper''' was stationed aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]] near [[Tractor Beam 12]] when the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' was captured by the [[battle station]]. While deactivating the tractor beam, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] heard the stormtrooper respond to a [[Unidentified stormtrooper (Tractor Beam 12)|fellow trooper's]] question about the [[BT-16]].<ref name="Episode 4" />
